The [[Deldrimor Scythe]] was introduced in the [[Game updates/20080424|April 24, 2008 game update]] and is part of the Deldrimor set. It is inscribable.

==Acquisition==
Crafted by [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]] for: 10 {{plat}}, 10 {{Deldrimor Steel}}, and 10 {{steel}}.

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]] 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Inscription]]: None

==Dye==
[[Dye]] affects the scythe's wrapping. The default color can be closely replicated using brown dye.
